description: Construction of Shilpa Kala Gammanaya, Mahawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-06-05
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayake, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to establish the Shilpa Kala Gammanaya in the village of Digana in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mahawa, was approved by the Cabinet.
